# v3.0.1 — Module 3 Visual-Quality Correction

## Module 3 visual and editorial correction

- Replaces the repeated five-box workflow template with 35 topic-specific decision visuals.
- Introduces matrices, stage gates, cost structures, comparison views, control loops, scorecards, evidence maps, and execution flows matched to the lesson concepts.
- Confirms raster review of all Module 3 visuals at full and narrow display widths with no clipped or overlapping labels.
- Corrects one malformed duplicated sentence in the landed-cost lesson and stale repository inventory totals.
- Adds a reproducible visual generator and an automated diversity safeguard to prevent the generic-template problem from returning.
